assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and its therapeutic translation have transformed treatment of diabetes and obesity, with broad and sustained medical consequences.
assessment.attribution: Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker represent central physiological, molecular, and translational elements of the credited discovery.
assessment.maturity: The biology and clinical benefit of incretin therapies are extensively established across major patient populations.
uncertainties: The discovery-to-therapy pathway involved further important contributors, including drug-development work not represented among the proposed laureates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like-particle HPV vaccines provide a compelling example of preventive molecular medicine with major potential to avert cancers worldwide.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed laureates are the complete credited set and jointly reflect the core vaccine-discovery work.
assessment.maturity: Long-term population use and prevention of HPV infection and related disease make the impact highly mature.
uncertainties: The relative division of conceptual and experimental credit among the three requires careful historical assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CAR-T cells established a powerful therapeutic principle: genetically directing immune cells to treat otherwise refractory cancers.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio covers key credited clinical and cellular-engineering contributions within the supplied candidate definition.
assessment.maturity: Durable responses and expanding clinical use establish the approach, while its long-term scope continues to develop.
uncertainties: Credit for foundational CAR design, clinical development, and distinct disease applications is inherently distributed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing converted a mechanistic RNA insight into an effective treatment for a devastating inherited disease.
assessment.attribution: Krainer and Bennett provide a concise and plausible pairing of splicing biology and therapeutic antisense development.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy has made this a mature proof that targeted manipulation of splicing can alter disease course.
uncertainties: The generalizability of this therapeutic strategy beyond spinal muscular atrophy remains less established.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA enabled a major noninvasive diagnostic advance in prenatal medicine and reshaped clinical screening practice.
assessment.attribution: The supplied candidate identifies a single credited investigator, yielding unusually clear attribution.
assessment.maturity: The method has been implemented at scale and its diagnostic performance has been extensively evaluated.
uncertainties: Its status as screening rather than definitive diagnosis remains an important clinical qualification.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adult stem-cell-derived organoids opened an experimentally tractable route to study human tissue maintenance, disease, and individualized therapeutic response.
assessment.attribution: Clevers and Sato are a focused credited pair for the defining adult stem-cell organoid advance.
assessment.maturity: The approach is broadly adopted and biologically productive, with translational applications continuing to mature.
uncertainties: How completely organoids reproduce in vivo tissue physiology varies by organ and application.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics created a uniquely powerful way to test causal roles of defined cells in physiology and behavior with temporal precision.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates span microbial light-sensitive proteins and their influential deployment for neural control.
assessment.maturity: The method is established across neuroscience and has generated enduring experimental capabilities.
uncertainties: The foundational work is distributed across more than three credited investigators, making a three-person award difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Identification of integrins established a central molecular framework for adhesion, migration, immunity, and tissue organization.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed laureates constitute the full credited set and represent complementary receptor and ligand biology.
assessment.maturity: The discovery has remained foundational for decades and has informed both basic and translational biology.
uncertainties: The breadth of the integrin field makes boundaries between this credited discovery and contributions by other investigators difficult to draw.
